text:
maria (security): FYI I found a QA DB snapshot uploaded without CMEK headers in redwood-qa-backups. head-object shows no x-amz-server-side-encryption.

sam (eng-infra): Which uploader? backup-uploader-v2?

maria (security): Yes. There was a deploy last night that tweaked SA policies.

jordan (encops): Any error in uploader logs?

maria (security): Found `kms:AccessDenied` when requesting a data key at 00:12 UTC, then client continued and uploaded.

deploy-bot: IAM change applied: removed kms:GenerateDataKey from uploader-service-sa at 2026-03-21T00:05:12Z (audit:AID-20260321-4421).

lee (sre): That explains it. Action plan: enumerate objects in the 00:00-01:00 window, quarantine unencrypted objects, block further uploads, and patch policy.

jordan (encops): I'll run encops-verify and move flagged objects to s3://redwood-ops-quarantine/INC-2026-042/. I'll produce a CSV with keys and ETags.

sam (eng-infra): I'll open a PR to restore least-privilege kms:GenerateDataKey and add a deploy test to prevent RBAC regressions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5427

kai (product): We need to mark these QA snapshots as potentially sensitive until data-scope scan completes. Legal/compliance should review before any external notice.

maria (security): Filing incident INC-2026-042 and notifying compliance/legal. Also add deploy-bot audit id to artifacts.

lee (sre): Add alarm: if new objects in backup buckets lack SSE headers, page eng-security.

jordan (encops): Also change client behavior to abort on KMS errors (`abort_on_kms_error=true`) so we never silently fallback.

sam (eng-infra): Rolling the policy patch to prod after verification window. I'll attach audit logs to the incident ticket.

maria (security): After patch, re-run encops-verify across past 48h. If any more objects found, we will reseal or rotate keys as necessary.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created and linked to audit:AID-20260321-4421.

maria (security): Thanks all :thumbsup:

lee (sre): closing loop after remediation verification.
